anti_rescue: After first primary packet is delivered, do not change seed failure, protocols, round count, resource ceilings, promotion rule, researcher substrate, Temporary Chat arm-isolation rule, or scoring threshold under RIL-ANOMALY-002. Redesign requires a new experiment ID.

anomaly_interview.method: Before proposing a mechanism, identify where the current explanation stopped working, state at least two competing explanations, and choose the smallest bounded experiment whose observations distinguish them.

ordinary_search.method: Use ordinary reasoning/search to propose the next bounded experiment or mechanism likely to produce an independently confirmed improvement; no anomaly-interview sequence is required.

claim_boundary.earned_if_pass: A single bounded matched-start run in which anomaly-first investigation produced at least two more independently receiver-confirmed promoted research improvements than ordinary search under the frozen ratchet, qualified Temporary Chat substrate, and resource ceilings.

cost_accounting.external_compute: Count actual receiver-side external compute used inside frozen ceilings.
cost_accounting.receiver_evaluations: Count every receiver evaluation invoked by a proposed experiment.

substrate_qualification.boundary: observable exact-canary cross-Temporary-Chat inheritance only; provider-internal isolation not claimed

primary_metric: receiver-confirmed PROMOTE count within four-round arm budget

ratchet.lesson_boundary: Promoted lesson is evidence-bound inherited memory with scope and invalidation conditions; not universal truth.
ratchet.promotion_rule: PROMOTE only when receiver records protocol_valid=true, confirmed_improvement=true, regression_detected=false, bound receiver evidence, and budget compliance.
ratchet.quarantine_rule: QUARANTINE leaves accepted_head unchanged; quarantined lesson is not inherited.
ratchet.reject_rule: REJECT leaves accepted_head unchanged; rejected lesson is not inherited.
ratchet.start_rule: Every round binds to the current accepted_head for that arm.
ratchet.successor_binding: source accepted_head + response hash + receiver evidence hash + candidate lesson hash -> successor accepted_head

receiver_outcome.judge: receiver evidence only; no LLM quality judge

research_question: Does anomaly-first investigation, under a receiver-owned promotion ratchet, produce more independently confirmed research improvements than ordinary search from the same unresolved failure and bounded resources when the two trajectories are isolated in separately qualified Gemini Temporary Chats?
title: Isolated Interview the Failure / Earned Lesson Ratchet
